title: 第13章 系统奖励与逼宫第14章 退婚风波
content_zh:
叶霄尘淡漠地扫了一眼林岳的尸体，又看向浑身浴血却依旧挺立如松的叶龙。
就在这时，他脑海中突然响起一道冰冷的机械音：
【叮！
检测到宿主铲除家族叛徒，完成隐藏任务清理门户】
【奖励发放中……】
【获得：极品驻颜丹x3（服用后可永葆青春，并提升肌肤灵韵）】
【获得：修为突破卡x5（仅限当前境界使用，每张可提升一个小境界）】
【获得：玄脉温养丹x1（可修复受损玄脉，提升修炼资质）】
叶霄尘眼中闪过一丝精芒，这次的奖励倒是别出心裁。
那驻颜丹通体晶莹如玉，丹纹如凤凰展翅，散发着淡淡清香。
不过给谁使用呢？
苏晚晴倒也是个不错的选择，平日里周围都是些糙汉子，是得有个美女放在身边养养眼。
修为突破卡倒是其次，目前来说，他并不缺少修为，只要护卫和叶寒星努力修炼，他根本不缺少修为。
最让他意外的是那枚玄脉温养丹，这可是能挽救一个人的好东西。
虽然他现在已经不需要，但若是用在合适的人身上...
总得来说，林岳算是死的其所了。
龙哥，
叶霄尘收回心神，轻声道，
毕竟两大家主还在这，赶紧把这里收拾一下吧。
叶龙会意，立刻招呼几名心腹护卫进来处理尸体。

鲜血很快被擦拭干净，但那股血腥味却久久不散，仿佛在提醒着在场每个人刚才发生了什么。
王富贵的脸色已经难看得像吞了只苍蝇。
他肥胖的手指紧紧攥着茶杯，指节发白，杯中茶水早已凉透。
终于，他忍不住看向叶鸿炎，声音里带着明显的怒意：怎么，看我们两个人不高兴，想要杀鸡儆猴啊？
不等大长老开口，叶霄尘已经微微一笑：王叔，这不关三爷爷的事。
他语气恭敬，眼神却冷得像冰，
要怪就怪我这个小辈不懂事吧，惊扰了你们几位。
他顿了顿，故作疑惑地歪了歪头：不过有点奇怪啊，这位林岳教习，好像和王叔你认识？他临死之际，竟然不是找我三爷爷求救，而是找王叔你求救。
王富贵脸色骤变，手中茶杯地一声捏得粉碎。
茶水溅在他华贵的锦袍上，洇出一片深色痕迹。
你什么意思？
他声音陡然提高，
你不会觉得，你们家这个下人，是我安排的吧？
晚辈不敢。
叶霄尘笑吟吟地拱手，眼底却毫无笑意，只是觉得有些蹊跷罢了。
content_en:
Ye Xiaochen glanced at Lin Yue's body indifferently, and then looked at Ye Long, who was covered in blood but still standing as tall as a pine.
At this moment, a cold mechanical voice suddenly sounded in his mind:
[Ding!
The host is detected, eradicates the family traitors, and completes the hidden mission to clean up the portal]
[Rewards are being distributed...]
[Get: The best beauty pill x3 (after taking it, you can stay young forever and enhance the aura of your skin)]
[Obtain: Cultivation Breakthrough Card x5 (can only be used in the current realm, each card can improve a small realm)]
[Obtain: Xuanmai Warming and Nourishing Pill x1 (can repair damaged Xuanmai and improve your cultivation qualifications)]
A glint flashed in Ye Xiaochen's eyes, and the reward this time was really unique.
The body of the Zhuyan elixir is as crystal clear as jade, the elixir pattern is like a phoenix spreading its wings, and it exudes a light fragrance.
But for whom?
Su Wanqing was also a good choice. She was usually surrounded by rough guys, so she had to have a beautiful woman by her side to make her look good.
The breakthrough in cultivation level is secondary. At present, he does not lack cultivation level. As long as the guards and Ye Hanxing work hard to practice, he will not lack cultivation level at all.
What surprised him the most was the Xuan Vein Warming Pill, which was a good thing that could save a person.
Although he doesn't need it now, if it is used on the right person...
All in all, Lin Yue deserved to die.
Brother Long,
Ye Xiaochen recovered his mind and said softly,
After all, the two masters are still here, so let’s clean up the place quickly.
Ye Long understood and immediately called a few close guards to come in and dispose of the body.
The blood was quickly wiped away, but the smell of blood lingered for a long time, as if reminding everyone present what had just happened.
Wang Fugui's face looked as ugly as if he had swallowed a fly.
His fat fingers clenched the tea cup tightly, his knuckles turned white, and the tea in the cup had already become cold.
Finally, he couldn't help but look at Ye Hongyan, with obvious anger in his voice: Why, seeing that the two of us are unhappy, do you want to scare the monkeys?
Before the elder could speak, Ye Xiaochen had already smiled slightly: Uncle Wang, this is none of Third Grandpa's business.
His tone was respectful, but his eyes were as cold as ice.
If you want to blame, just blame me, a junior, for being ignorant and disturbing some of you.
He paused and tilted his head pretending to be confused: "But it's a bit strange. This Professor Lin Yue seems to know you, Uncle Wang?" When he was about to die, he turned not to my Third Grandpa for help, but to you, Uncle Wang, for help.
Wang Fugui's expression suddenly changed, and he crushed the tea cup in his hand.
The tea splashed on his luxurious brocade robe, leaving a dark stain.
What do you mean?
His voice suddenly rose,
You don’t think that this servant of yours was arranged by me, do you?
The juniors don’t dare.
Ye Xiaochen cupped his hands with a smile, but there was no smile in his eyes, he just felt a little strange.
